rules.match: ^MassModels_Lelli2016c\.mrt:data row (?P<row>\d+), column (?P<column>Vgas): atomic gas with helium \(factor 1\.33\)$
rules.note: The factor 1.33 (helium) is stated in S3 §3.3, l. 199.

rules.match: ^MassModels_Lelli2016c\.mrt:data row (?P<row>\d+), column (?P<column>Vgas): atomic gas with helium \(factor 1\.33\); gas profile assumed exponential \(arXiv:1606\.09251 §3\.4\)$
rules.note: The value is read from S1 (row, column). The gas-profile assumption is stated in S3 §3.3 (Mass Models), SPARC.tex l. 199, not §3.4 as the source_ref says; the paper has no §3.4 (known issue #222).

rules.match: ^SPARC_Lelli2016c\.mrt:data row (?P<row>\d+), columns D and e_D; method f_D=(?P<fd>[1-5]) \(.+; arXiv:1606\.09251 §2\.2\)$
rules.note: Values from S2; the distance methods are described in S3 §2.2 (Galaxy Distances), SPARC.tex l. 113–121.
